Testing if Cpr - pre and post-fire disturbance contributes to model fit

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(randomForest)
library(zoo)
library(lubridate)

set.seed(42)

predictors <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "cumulative_cwd_7day")

compute_metrics <- function(obs, pred) {
  data.frame(
    R2   = round(cor(obs, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2, 3),
    RMSE = round(sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)), 3),
    NSE  = round(1 - sum((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE) /
                     sum((obs - mean(obs, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  )
}

# ── Prepare Cpr ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cpr <- sites_daily[["Cpr"]] %>%
  drop_na(GPP, Tair, SW_rad, VPD, cwd, Precip, date) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    cumulative_cwd_7day = rollapply(
      cwd, width = 7, FUN = sum,
      align = "right", fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(predictors), GPP)

formula  <- as.formula(paste("GPP ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
mtry_val <- max(2, floor(sqrt(length(predictors))))

# ── Define periods ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Pre-fire:         2010-2013 — stable mature woodland
# Recovery:         2014-2019 — excluded from period-specific tests
# Post-recovery:    2020-2024 — recovered vegetation, new stable regime
cpr_pre  <- cpr %>% filter(year >= 2010 & year <= 2013)
cpr_post <- cpr %>% filter(year >= 2020 & year <= 2024)
cpr_full <- cpr  # full record for baseline LOYO

cat("Pre-fire rows:       ", nrow(cpr_pre),  " | years:", paste(unique(cpr_pre$year),  collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Post-recovery rows:  ", nrow(cpr_post), " | years:", paste(unique(cpr_post$year), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Full record rows:    ", nrow(cpr_full), " | years:", paste(unique(cpr_full$year), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ── Helper: LOYO within a data subset ────────────────────────────────────────
run_loyo_subset <- function(df, label) {
  years <- unique(df$year)
  if (length(years) < 2) {
    message("Skipping ", label, ": fewer than 2 years")
    return(NULL)
  }

  map_dfr(years, function(yr) {
    train_df <- df %>% filter(year != yr)
    test_df  <- df %>% filter(year == yr)
    if (nrow(train_df) < 50 || nrow(test_df) < 10) return(NULL)

    rf <- randomForest(formula, data = train_df,
                       ntree = 500, mtry = mtry_val, importance = FALSE)

    data.frame(
      label    = label,
      year     = yr,
      date     = test_df$date,
      GPP_obs  = test_df$GPP,
      GPP_pred = predict(rf, test_df)
    )
  })
}

# ── Test 1: Full record LOYO ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
loyo_full <- run_loyo_subset(cpr_full, "Full record LOYO\n(2010-2024)")

# ── Test 2: Pre-fire LOYO (2010-2013) ─────────────────────────────────────────
loyo_pre <- run_loyo_subset(cpr_pre, "Pre-fire LOYO\n(2010-2013)")

# ── Test 3: Post-recovery LOYO (2020-2024) ────────────────────────────────────
loyo_post <- run_loyo_subset(cpr_post, "Post-recovery LOYO\n(2020-2024)")

# ── Test 4: Train pre-fire, test post-recovery ────────────────────────────────
# Direct test of regime shift — if fire changed GPP-climate relationship,
# pre-fire training should predict post-recovery poorly
rf_pre <- randomForest(formula, data = cpr_pre,
                       ntree = 500, mtry = mtry_val, importance = FALSE)

cross_fire <- data.frame(
  label    = "Train pre-fire /\nTest post-recovery",
  year     = cpr_post$year,
  date     = cpr_post$date,
  GPP_obs  = cpr_post$GPP,
  GPP_pred = predict(rf_pre, cpr_post)
)

# ── Metrics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_results <- bind_rows(loyo_full, loyo_pre, loyo_post, cross_fire) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = c(
    "Full record LOYO\n(2010-2024)",
    "Pre-fire LOYO\n(2010-2013)",
    "Post-recovery LOYO\n(2020-2024)",
    "Train pre-fire /\nTest post-recovery"
  )))

metrics <- all_results %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(compute_metrics(GPP_obs, GPP_pred), .groups = "drop")

cat("\n── AU-Cpr fire regime shift diagnostic ──\n")
print(metrics)

```

```{r}

# ── Plot 1: Obs vs predicted time series per test ─────────────────────────────
ts_df <- all_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(GPP_obs, GPP_pred),
               names_to = "type", values_to = "GPP") %>%
  mutate(type = recode(type, GPP_obs = "Observed", GPP_pred = "Predicted"))

metric_labels <- metrics %>%
  mutate(ann_label = paste0("R² = ", R2, "  NSE = ", NSE))

p_ts <- ggplot(ts_df, aes(x = date, y = GPP, colour = type, alpha = type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(
    data        = metric_labels,
    aes(label   = ann_label),
    x           = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust       = -0.05, vjust = 1.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3, colour = "grey20", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # Fire event marker on full record panel only
  geom_vline(
    data = data.frame(
      label = factor("Full record LOYO\n(2010-2024)",
                     levels = levels(ts_df$label)),
      xint  = as.Date("2014-01-15")
    ),
    aes(xintercept = xint),
    linetype = "dashed", colour = "#CC6677", linewidth = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ label, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Observed"  = "#2c2c2c",
                                 "Predicted" = "#88CCEE")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values  = c("Observed"  = 0.45,
                                 "Predicted" = 0.9)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(
    title    = "AU-Cpr: Fire regime shift diagnostic",
    subtitle = "Red dashed line = January 2014 wildfire | Recovery period (2014-2019) excluded from period-specific tests",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = expression(GPP ~ (g ~ C ~ m^{-2} ~ d^{-1})),
    colour   = NULL, alpha = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 9),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey94", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

# ── Plot 2: R² comparison bar chart ───────────────────────────────────────────
p_r2 <- ggplot(metrics, aes(x = label, y = R2, fill = R2)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = R2), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold", colour = "grey20") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.07, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#CC6677", linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 0.08,
           label = "Full record\nbaseline (R²=0.07)",
           hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = "#CC6677", fontface = "italic") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#E06C4B", high = "#4682B4",
                      limits = c(0, 1), oob = scales::squish) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "AU-Cpr: R² by modelling period",
    subtitle = "Improvement over full-record LOYO (R²=0.07) indicates fire-induced non-stationarity",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "R²"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 9),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

print(p_ts)
print(p_r2)
```
